feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 20 May 2026 8:38am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 20 May 2026 at 8:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure northwest of Ireland, moving eastwards, with associated fronts and troughs affecting Britain and Ireland.


##Wind##

Southwest 5 this morning, occasionally 6 in a few places, then decreasing 4 or 5 this afternoon. Backing South or Southwest this evening, then increasing mainly 5 or 6 tonight, although staying 4 or 5 in Liverpool Bay and Morecambe Bay.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, locally slight in Liverpool Bay.


##Weather##

Fair, then rain, drizzle and mist patches arriving overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain, drizzle and mist patches later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Continuing mainly South or Southwest 5 or 6 tomorrow morning and afternoon, although 3 or 4 in Liverpool Bay and Morecambe Bay. Backing and decreasing South or Southeast 3 or 4 in all waters during the evening and at first overnight, then veering South or Southwest 4 or 5 later in the night or at first on Friday morning.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, becoming slight or moderate. Locally slight throughout in Liverpool Bay.


##Weather##

Continuing risk of mist patches, but many areas becoming fair.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, but poor in mist patches.
